results.title: The Grizzlie Truth
results.overview: To die-hard fans of NBA franchise, the Vancouver Grizzlies, like filmmaker Kat Jayme, the team’s abrupt move to Memphis in 2001 is much more than a sore spot, it’s an unsolved mystery and possibly a criminal conspiracy. What begins as a superfan’s investigation into her hometown team’s disappearance, becomes a love letter to the worst professional sports franchise in history, and an exploration of the deep roots of fandom.

results.title: Women on Trial
results.overview: 1972. A landmark trial shakes France as young Marie-Claire is prosecuted for having an illegal abortion with the help of her mother and two other defendants. In a courtroom governed by men, the verdict seems inevitable: prison for the women, while the rapist goes unpunished. Their last hope lies with Gisèle Halimi, a fearless lawyer known for openly challenging patriarchy and confronting the system that condemns victims and lets perpetrators walk free. Alongside the accused, Gisèle will not only change their fate, but, against all odds, transform the condition of women forever

results.title: The Arab
results.overview: Haroun is an old bachelor who has lived in Oran for several years. A retired civil servant, he leads a reclusive life until the day he meets Kamel in a bar—a journalist to whom he tells an incredible story dating back to 1942. He claims to be the brother of ‘the Arab’ killed in a story told in one of the most famous novels of the 20th century, ‘The Stranger’ by Albert Camus. An Arab with an erased name: Moussa. Through anger, assertions, details, and confidences, Haroun finally convinces the journalist to listen to his story. His confession is a cry of freedom and distress—but above all, a cry of revolt: against an abusive mother, against a country that failed to achieve true independence, against a book, and against a famous French writer.

results.title: My Tiny Little School
results.overview: With Ma toute petite école, Pascal Plisson follows, over the course of a year, the school life of the eight children living in the tiny hamlet of La Gurraz, in the Haute Tarentaise region. At the heart of this village of just 36 inhabitants, their school, threatened with closure, represents far more than a place of learning: it is the soul of an isolated community, where every birth and every pupil helps keep the village alive.

results.title: Bon appetit
results.overview: The way to a man’s heart is through his stomach.

results.title: The Search for Dinner
results.overview: After a chaotic neighbour eats everything in the house, a starving Matthew sets off in a hunger-fuelled trance that leads him into one bizarre food disaster after another. His brother Benji, their gang-affiliated cousin Peter and the very neighbour who caused it all must find him before it’s too late.

results.title: HYPOTHETICALLY
results.overview: On the morning of their last A-level exam before leaving for university, Dan decides to tell his best friend Joe something he's been keeping to himself. Nervous and unable to say what he really means, Dan hides behind a series of hypotheticals, trying to discover how Joe might react if someone liked their best friend.

results.title: Boksburg sonder brieke
results.overview: When Vonk Vlok, a Boksburg mechanic, unexpectedly appears in the infamous Epstein files, his family's quiet existence is thrown into total chaos. As he tries to explain how he got involved in the scandal, family problems, social media drama and old secrets come together to lead to a collision of epic proportions.

results.title: Primetime Production Diary
results.overview: Go behind the scenes with Primetime director Lance Oppenheim in a new making-of mini doc directed by Wes Ellis and Christian Vazquez & edited by Wes Ellis.

results.title: Das Monument bewegt sich
results.overview: Documentary about rememberance of the victims of military dictatorship in Argentinia.

results.title: Nnéoma
results.overview: A mother's greatest mistake becomes her chance at redemption when love demands the ultimate sacrifice.

results.title: Something That Sticks
results.overview: A conversation between Derrick Gloop and William Fletch about the worst masks known to humanity- the ones that don't cover your face.

results.title: Forgotten War
results.overview: Narrated by Steve Paikin, Forgotten War explores post-World War II conflicts through the eyes of Canadian veterans. This is an existing TVO-produced series, edited into an hour-long program and includes conflicts in Korea, Afghanistan, Cyprus, and the former Yugoslavia.

results.title: The Fleeting Rhythm
results.overview: What does it take to leave the only place you've ever called home and chase your sound somewhere new? Following Jacob Ledesma, a producer from Reno, Nevada, as he packs up and moves to the Bay Area to take his music to the next level.

results.title: American Woodcock
results.overview: What's that buzzy sound? It's the woodcock, baby!

results.title: The Corselet
results.overview: Inspired by Andrea Mantegna's 'The Triumphs of Caesar ', shot on 16mm and hand-processed using nettles from Cornish woodlands, this film acts as a follow-up to Dubieniec's eco-somatic debut short 'Moth Wood'
